contract.identity: sourcebook + canonical tree + canonical talent name
contract.canonicalDescription: Source-backed Starships of the Galaxy rule text.

records.canonicalIdentity: Starships of the Galaxy|Sense|Force Reflexes
records.canonicalDescription: When activating a starship maneuver, you may spend a Force Point to reroll your Pilot check, keeping the better result. See Chapter 2 for more information on starship maneuvers.
records.canonicalPrerequisites: Force Sensitivity, Starship Tactics, Force Pilot
records.quickSummary: Spend a Force Point when activating a starship maneuver to reroll the Pilot check and keep the better result.
records.repoBenefit: When activating a starship maneuver, reroll the Pilot check.
records.repoDescription: When activating a starship maneuver, reroll the Pilot check.

records.canonicalIdentity: Starships of the Galaxy|Lineage|Engineer
records.canonicalDescription: You are trained in the Mechanics skill. Additionally, when installing new systems into a vehicle, the efficiency of your designs reduces the time it takes to install the system by 25%.
records.canonicalPrerequisites: Educated, trained in the Knowledge (technology) skill
records.quickSummary: Become trained in Mechanics and reduce vehicle-system installation time by 25%.
records.repoBenefit: Trained in Mechanics; time to install new vehicle systems reduced by 25%.
records.repoDescription: Reduce time required to install vehicle systems by 25%.

records.canonicalIdentity: Starships of the Galaxy|Outlaw Tech|Fast Repairs
records.canonicalDescription: Whenever you jury-rig an object or vehicle, the vehicle gains a number of temporary hit points equal to the result of your Mechanics check. Damage is subtracted from these temporary hit points first, and temporary hit points go away at the conclusion of the encounter.
records.quickSummary: Jury-rigging grants temporary hit points equal to your Mechanics check result for the encounter.
records.repoBenefit: When you jury-rig a vehicle, it regains hit points equal to your Mechanics check result.
records.repoDescription: When jury-rigging a vehicle, restore hit points equal to your Mechanics check.
records.notes: Repository says jury-rigging restores hit points; source grants temporary hit points that expire at encounter end.

records.canonicalIdentity: Starships of the Galaxy|Outlaw Tech|Hot Wire
records.canonicalDescription: You can use your Mechanics check modifier instead of your Use Computer check modifier when making Use Computer checks to improve access to a computer system. You are considered trained in the Use Computer skill for purposes of using this talent. If you are entitled to a Use Computer check reroll, you may reroll your Mechanics check instead (subject to the same circumstances and limitations).
records.quickSummary: Use Mechanics instead of Use Computer to improve computer access, including qualifying rerolls.
records.repoBenefit: Use Mechanics instead of Use Computer to improve computer access; you are considered trained.
records.repoDescription: Use Mechanics instead of Use Computer to improve access to systems.

records.canonicalIdentity: Starships of the Galaxy|Outlaw Tech|Quick Fix
records.canonicalDescription: Once per encounter, you may jury-rig an object or vehicle that is not disabled. All normal benefits and penalties for jury-rigging still apply.
records.quickSummary: Once per encounter, jury-rig an object or vehicle even if it is not disabled.
records.repoBenefit: Once per encounter, jury-rig an object that is not disabled.
records.repoDescription: Once per encounter, jury-rig an object that is not disabled.

records.canonicalIdentity: Starships of the Galaxy|Outlaw Tech|Personalized Modifications
records.canonicalDescription: As a standard action, you may tweak the settings, grips, and moving parts of a powered weapon you wield, tailoring it to your needs. For the remainder of the encounter, you gain a +1 equipment bonus on attack rolls and a +2 equipment bonus on damage rolls with that weapon. You can use this talent only on powered weapons (those that require a power cell to operate), including weapons connected to a larger power source (such as vehicle and starship weapons).
records.quickSummary: As a standard action, tune a powered weapon you wield for +1 attack and +2 damage for the encounter.
records.repoBenefit: For powered weapons you are using, gain +1 attack and +2 damage for the rest of the encounter.
records.repoDescription: Powered weapons you use gain +1 attack and +2 damage for the encounter.

records.canonicalIdentity: Starships of the Galaxy|Expert Pilot|Blind Spot
records.canonicalDescription:
You can fly a vehicle you pilot so close to a target at least two sizes larger than your vehicle that it is difficult for the target to avoid or attack you. You must be adjacent to the target (at starship scale) to use this talent. As a swift action, make an opposed Pilot check against the target. If you succeed, you move into the same space as your target. You move with your target if it moves (assuming your vehicle has sufficient speed to keep up), and you must make another opposed Pilot check each round as a swift action to stay in its blind spot.

As long as you stay in the target's blind spot, any attack you make against the target gains a +2 bonus, and the target takes a -2 penalty on attacks made against you.
records.quickSummary: Enter and maintain the blind spot of an adjacent vehicle at least two sizes larger to gain +2 attacks against it while it takes -2 attacks against you.
records.repoBenefit: Against a vehicle two sizes bigger that must be adjacent, make an opposed Pilot check; if you win, your attack vs that target +2 and their attacks vs you -2.
records.repoDescription: When adjacent to a vehicle two sizes larger, make an opposed Pilot check; you gain +2 attack and the target takes –2 attack.

records.canonicalIdentity: Starships of the Galaxy|Expert Pilot|Close Scrape
records.canonicalDescription: Whenever you are piloting a vehicle of Colossal size or smaller, you may make a Pilot check as a reaction to turn a critical hit into a normal hit. The DC for the Pilot check is equal to the attack roll total of the critical hit. If you are successful, the damage from the attack is not doubled (though it is still considered an automatic hit).
records.quickSummary: React to a critical hit while piloting Colossal-or-smaller craft; a Pilot check against the attack total converts it to a normal hit.
records.repoBenefit: Against a colossal size or smaller vehicle, a successful Pilot check turns a critical hit into a normal hit.
records.repoDescription: When piloting a Colossal or smaller vehicle, a successful Pilot check turns a critical hit into a normal hit.

records.canonicalIdentity: Starships of the Galaxy|Expert Pilot|Improved Attack Run
records.canonicalDescription: You do not have to move in a straight line when using the attack run action.
records.quickSummary: Attack runs no longer require straight-line movement.
records.repoBenefit: You are not required to move in a straight line when making an attack run.
records.repoDescription: You do not need to move in a straight line during an attack run.

records.canonicalIdentity: Starships of the Galaxy|Expert Pilot|Vehicle Focus
records.canonicalDescription: Choose a single type of vehicle from the following list: airspeeder, capital ship, space transport, speeder, starfighter, or walker. When you are the pilot or gunner of that type of vehicle, you gain +2 to all attack rolls with a vehicle weapon, and may take 10 on any Pilot checks made while piloting that type of vehicle, even when you are otherwise unable to.
records.quickSummary: Choose a vehicle type; while piloting or gunning it, gain +2 vehicle-weapon attacks and may take 10 on Pilot checks.
records.repoBenefit: Gain +2 attack with a selected vehicle type and may take 10 on Pilot checks for that vehicle.
records.repoDescription: Gain +2 attack with a selected vehicle type and may take 10 on Pilot checks with it.

records.canonicalIdentity: Starships of the Galaxy|Expert Pilot|Wingman
records.canonicalDescription: As a swift action, you can make a DC 15 Pilot check to assist any allied starfighter or airspeeder within 2 squares at starship scale. If you succeed, the pilot of that vehicle gains a +5 bonus on all opposed Pilot checks relating to the dogfight action until the start of your next turn.
records.quickSummary: Swift DC 15 Pilot check grants a nearby allied starfighter or airspeeder +5 on opposed dogfight Pilot checks until your next turn.
records.repoBenefit: As a swift action, assist an allied starfighter within 2 squares to grant +5 Pilot in a dogfight.
records.repoDescription: Assist an allied starfighter within 2 squares; ally gains +5 Pilot checks in dogfights.

records.canonicalIdentity: Starships of the Galaxy|Gunner|Crippling Hit
records.canonicalDescription: Whenever you make an attack that causes a vehicle to move -1 or more steps down the condition track, you may also cause it to lose one of the following systems: hyperdrive, one weapon or weapon battery, or communications. The system remains inoperative until the target regains all steps on the condition track.
records.quickSummary: When your attack moves a vehicle down the condition track, disable its hyperdrive, one weapon/battery, or communications until it fully recovers.
records.repoBenefit: If your attack moves a ship down the track, it may lose hyperdrive, weapons, or communications.
records.repoDescription: If a System Hit moves a ship down the track, disable one system such as weapons, hyperdrive, or communications.

records.canonicalIdentity: Starships of the Galaxy|Gunner|Great Shot
records.canonicalDescription: When firing a vehicle weapon, you treat the distance to the target as though it were one range category less than it actually is. For example, when targeting an enemy at short range, you treat it as though it were at point blank range for the purpose of determining bonuses or penalties.
records.quickSummary: Treat vehicle-weapon targets as one range category closer for range bonuses and penalties.
records.repoBenefit: Reduce range penalties by one category (for example, short becomes point-blank).
records.repoDescription: Reduce range penalties by one category.

records.canonicalIdentity: Starships of the Galaxy|Gunner|Synchronized Fire
records.canonicalDescription: Once per encounter, you may ready to fire a single weapon at the same target as an ally, and you coordinate with a single weapon of your ally. If both attacks hit, you add the damage of the two weapons together before applying the target's SR or DR, and treat it as a single attack for purposes of exceeding the target's damage threshold.
records.quickSummary: Once per encounter, coordinate one weapon with an ally so two successful hits combine before SR/DR and damage-threshold comparison.
records.repoBenefit: Once per encounter, coordinate an attack with an ally on the same target to overcome SR, DR, and Threshold together.
records.repoDescription: Once per encounter, treat your attack and an ally's attack against the same target as one against shields, damage reduction, and threshold.

records.canonicalIdentity: Starships of the Galaxy|Squadron Leader|Begin Attack Run
records.canonicalDescription: As a swift action, you designate a single target. When using the attack run action against that target, vehicles in your squadron gain a +5 bonus on their attack rolls (instead of the normal +2). You may have only one target designated at a time.
records.quickSummary: Swiftly designate one target; squadron attack runs against it gain +5 instead of +2.
records.repoBenefit: Designate a single target and gain +5 attack with an attack run.
records.repoDescription: Designate a single target and gain +5 attack with attack runs.

records.canonicalIdentity: Starships of the Galaxy|Squadron Leader|Regroup
records.canonicalDescription: Once per encounter as a standard action, you can move all vehicles in your squadron +1 step on their condition tracks.
records.quickSummary: Once per encounter, standard action moves every squadron vehicle +1 step on the condition track.
records.repoBenefit: Once per encounter, move every ship in your squadron +1 up the condition track.
records.repoDescription: Once per encounter, move every ship in your squadron one step up the condition track.

records.canonicalIdentity: Starships of the Galaxy|Squadron Leader|Squadron Maneuvers
records.canonicalDescription: Choose one talent that you already possess. The talent you select must be from the Expert Pilot or Gunner talent trees. Once per encounter as a standard action, you can impart the benefits of the chosen talent to all members of your squadron. Once gained, its benefits last until the end of the encounter.
records.canonicalPrerequisites: Charisma 13, any other ace pilot talent
records.quickSummary: Choose one Expert Pilot or Gunner talent you possess; once per encounter, grant its benefits to your whole squadron for the encounter.
records.repoBenefit: Once per encounter, grant the prerequisite of a chosen talent to every ship in your squadron until the end of the encounter.
records.repoDescription: Once per encounter, grant the prerequisite of a talent to every ship in your squadron until the end of the encounter.
records.notes: Repository says it grants a prerequisite of a chosen talent; source grants the benefits of one Expert Pilot or Gunner talent you already possess to the squadron.

records.canonicalIdentity: Starships of the Galaxy|Squadron Leader|Squadron Tactics
records.canonicalDescription: Once per encounter, when you use a starship maneuver, you grant all ships in your squadron the ability to use the same maneuver once on their next turn. The pilot of each ship that chooses to use the maneuver must make any Pilot checks or attack rolls the maneuver requires—your success or failure with the maneuver has no bearing on the success of other units of your squadron.
records.canonicalPrerequisites: Charisma 13, Wisdom 13, any other ace pilot talent, Squadron Maneuvers, Starship Tactics
records.quickSummary: Once per encounter when you use a starship maneuver, each squadron ship may independently use that maneuver once on its next turn.
records.repoBenefit: Once per encounter, grant a maneuver you use to every ship in your squadron next round.
records.repoDescription: Once per encounter, grant a maneuver you use to every ship in your squadron next round.

records.canonicalIdentity: Starships of the Galaxy|Naval Officer|Combined Fire
records.canonicalDescription: As a swift action, you may designate a single creature, vehicle, or object within your line of sight as the target of combined fire. Any weapon batteries attacking that target deal an extra die of damage for every 2 points their attack roll exceeds the target's Reflex Defense (instead of every 3 points). In addition, when using the tactical fire option for a capital ship (see ship descriptions in Chapter 4), you may designate a weapon or weapon battery to make a single attack.
records.quickSummary: Swiftly designate a visible target; batteries gain damage dice every 2 points over Reflex, and tactical fire may designate one weapon/battery to attack.

sameNameRepoCandidates.name: Combined Fire
sameNameRepoCandidates.benefit: Deal +2 damage against targets damaged by an ally since the end of your last turn.
sameNameRepoCandidates.description: Designate a vehicle or target; batteries deal extra damage when using Tactical Fire.

records.notes: Same-name repository record belongs to a different canonical tree and must not be reused by display name alone.

records.canonicalIdentity: Starships of the Galaxy|Naval Officer|Fleet Deployment
records.canonicalDescription: As a full-round action, you can designate a number of vehicles equal to your class level and within your line of sight. Those vehicles may immediately move a number of squares equal to their speed.
records.quickSummary: Full-round action lets visible vehicles up to your class level immediately move their speed.
records.repoBenefit: A number of vehicles equal to your class level in line of sight may each move a number of squares equal to their speed.
records.repoDescription: Move a number of allied vehicles equal to your class level.

records.canonicalIdentity: Starships of the Galaxy|Naval Officer|Fleet Tactics
records.canonicalDescription: As a standard action, you may designate a single vehicle as the target of a large-scale assault. If you succeed on a DC 15 Knowledge (tactics) check, all allied gunners within line of sight deal 1 additional die of damage to the target with each successful ranged attack until the start of your next turn. This is a mind-affecting effect.
records.quickSummary: Standard action and DC 15 Knowledge (tactics) check grants visible allied gunners +1 damage die against one vehicle until your next turn.
records.repoBenefit: Designate a single vehicle; allied gunners in line of sight gain +1 damage die.
records.repoDescription: Allied gunners gain +1 die damage against a designated target.

records.canonicalIdentity: Starships of the Galaxy|Naval Officer|It's a Trap!
records.canonicalDescription: You are skilled at sensing the plans of enemy naval officers and counteracting them. Once per encounter as a reaction, you can grant the pilot of any single vehicle within line of sight (including a vehicle you are commanding) an immediate move action.
records.quickSummary: Once per encounter as a reaction, grant the pilot of one visible vehicle an immediate move action.
records.repoBenefit: Once per encounter set a trap for a single vehicle in line of sight that activates on that vehicle's immediate move action.
records.repoDescription: Once per encounter, force a vehicle in line of sight to immediately move.
records.notes: Repository wording suggests forcing a vehicle to move; source grants that vehicle's pilot an immediate move action.

records.canonicalIdentity: Starships of the Galaxy|Naval Officer|Legendary Commander
records.canonicalDescription: When you are the commander of a capital ship, calculate its Reflex Defense using your heroic level plus one-half the ship's armor bonus (round down), the pilot's heroic level, or the ship's armor bonus, whichever is more. In addition, all gunners on your ship add one-half your heroic level or one-half their heroic level, whichever is more, to damage rolls with vehicle weapons. Finally, you treat any generic crew as being one quality level higher (maximum of ace).
records.quickSummary: As capital-ship commander, improve Reflex calculation, gunner damage scaling, and generic crew quality.
records.repoBenefit: Gunners on your ship add half your heroic level (or half their HL) to damage and treat crew as one level higher; calculate capital ship Reflex Defense as your HL + 1/2 armor if higher.
records.repoDescription: Gunners add half heroic level to damage; calculate capital ship defenses using your heroic level.
